name: pour_cells
description: an acrylic pour with cells: streams of paint dragged into folds and veils, studded with round cells of every size, each a flat drop of another colour inside a dark rim, stretched along the flow

reference.made_with: a photograph of an acrylic pour, 6000x4000

reuses: stirred_ink's stir, one pass along the level lines of a turned copy
the smooth count through the map by rank, warped by a turned copy's count
the bubble trap's lattice (ring_pools' discs), read as `step` for each cell's flat colour and as an inverted `height` for its rim
notes: From wallhaven-exqwvk (item 089, triage group 11, poured paint), with wallhaven-yxlvkk as the entry crimson_cells. No new engine member. The pour is one stir pass (strength 3 over 4 steps, period 3) carrying the smooth count by rank, warped by a turned copy's count so the streams change colour across the folds. The cells are a bubble lattice (radius 0.35 at spacing 1, between 0.003 and 0.1 of the frame): its `step` read through the map at a third of a turn on is each cell's flat colour, and an inverted `height` glow at power 2 in the map's black darkens each cell towards its rim. The stir bends the round cells along the flow. Nearest mode: stirred_ink (the stir, but one lit glossy ink, no cells), its baseline tile in both formulation rows. ring_pools drew the same lattice's `height` through four cycles (tight contour rings): here a cell is one flat drop, never rings.
Reachable by one escape loop: yes. The frame's loop, the stir's four, the warp's view and the trap's own loop, no light, so no Jacobian.

Round one's readings: f_small (round one's first stack: radius 0.25, largest 0.05, a rim at power 6 that hardly showed at draft size), f_holes (the cells as dark holes under a pale rim, exqwvk's black cells), f_ringed (a pale ring screened inside the dark rim, yxlvkk's), f_calm (the stir at 1.2 over 2 steps), f_nocells (the pour alone). crimson_cells is the stack in its own map at yxlvkk's dark key (tone 0.148/0.093).
Tone held at all 14 picker tiles as shipped (median 0.251 to 0.257 against 0.254); crimson_cells at both its seats against yxlvkk.
Explorer cost (089, no held box: an upper bound): 44 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest formulation seat (phoenix_71e305f0, maxiter 11,030).
